title: Share with someone
headline: Share *with someone*
sub: Send a business or an order to a person; a stranger's message waits as a request.

bridge.en: Sharing is one person at a time. Next, a group.
bridge.pcm: Sharing na one person at a time. Next, group.

flow.action: Sits beside his mother on her sofa, turns his phone gently towards her and points at the screen with a smile
flow.setting: Mama Tobi's front room in Surulere, Lagos: a floral sofa, a framed family photo, a ceiling fan, warm afternoon light
flow.camera: medium two-shot, over the shoulder (screen not readable)

flow.action: Reads her phone with her glasses on, lips moving, then looks up and says something delighted to Tobi
flow.setting: Mama Tobi's front room in Surulere, Lagos: a floral sofa, a framed family photo, a ceiling fan, warm afternoon light

en: Found a business you like? Share it.
It says Shared. She gets a card.
An order shares the same way. Open Orders.
Open the order, tap Share with someone.
Pick Mama Tobi again and tap Send.
You are new to her, so it waits.
She taps Message requests, then your message.
Both cards show. Tobi is not told she read.
She accepts. Now he sees when she reads.
Chat with them starts her own chat.
